judgment_text:
Prayer in CMP No. 11381 of 2026: This Civil Miscellaneous Petition is filed to condone the delay of 4461 days in filing this second appeal

Prayer in SA Sr No. 45837 of 2026: second appeal filed under Section 100 CPC to set aside the decree and judgment dated 12-3-2013 made in A.S. No. 76 of 2011 on the file of VI Additional Judge, City Civil Court, Chennai, confirming the judgment and decree dated 12-8-2010 made in O.S. No. 6256 of 2003 on the file of II Assistant Judge, City Civil Court, Chennai with costs

ORDER

This civil miscellaneous petition has been filed to condone the delay of 4461 days in filing the second appeal.

2. It is seen from the typed set of papers that the judgment and decree in the first appeal was delivered on 12-3-2013 and copy application was filed on 13-3-2013 and the copies were made ready on 26-9-2013. However, the second appeal has been filed only on 1-3-2026. In the affidavit in support of the condone delay petition, it was simply stated by the petitioners that they got opinion from the advocate at Chennai to prefer the second appeal and immediately, they preferred the second appeal. The vague reason given 0 in the affidavit filed in support of the condone delay petition is not sufficient to condone such inordinate delay of 4461 days in filing the second appeal. Since the petitioners have not made out sufficient cause for condoning such the huge delay, this court is not inclined to entertain the petition.

3. Accordingly, this civil miscellaneous petition is dismissed. As a consequence, the second appeal is rejected in the SR stage itself. There shall be no order as to costs.
